name: cfcmt-bus-cross-city-native-v1
stage: Native target data interface admission; no trained-policy performance claim
prerequisite: bus_thesis_rule_confirmation_v1 PASS; fixed0250 vs forward_proportional gain0.6

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

observation.arrival_rate: Only actual observed passenger arrivals during the previous 1800 seconds; no future planned APC arrivals
observation.canonical_line_indices: Contiguous 0..n-1 with the same station_max mapping

transition: Record full native joint action sequence, executed hold, passenger-ledger delta reward, elapsed seconds and terminal tail; report dt=0 rows separately from physical boundary rows

planned_training.status: Not launched; training interface must be frozen before use
planned_training.budget_accounting: Unique union of target outcomes exposed to training or selection, including normalization/runtime calibration; all phases reuse only their allowed rows
planned_training.split_rule: Disjoint complete demand/SUMO day trajectories for fit, stop, calibrate and final test; no random row split across a day

branches.target_only: Target fit initialization, target fit adaptation, target replay continuation
branches.same_city: Same target initialization and adaptation, then target-city low-fidelity continuation with normalized confidence
branches.cross_city: Source-city initialization replaces target initialization, then identical target adaptation and target-city low-fidelity continuation

planned_training.compute_accounting: Same initialization, adaptation and continuation update counts across branches; source history is reported separately
planned_training.transfer: Controller parameters only; reset target adaptation optimizer and RNG identically
planned_training.checkpoint_rule: Fixed final checkpoint; no target test-driven selection
planned_training.world_model_fit_eligibility: At most 8192 positive-dt nonterminal rows from the fixed fit pool. Report actual eligible fit/stop/calibrate counts; do not expand the 16384-row target union to fill these caps.
planned_training.initialization_comparison: Cross-city replaces target initialization with source initialization; C-minus-B is the replacement effect under equal total updates and target data budget, not an extra-source effect with identical target gradient exposure.

interpretation: Admission verifies an actionable causal passenger-state interface and accounting, not cross-city transfer superiority. Retain the selected city and negative results; do not change line selection according to performance.
target_pool_rule: Each fixed full-day case contributes 2048 distinct uniformly-spaced raw transition indices, including its terminal tail; no reward-driven selection or replacement days. Store the source global trajectory id and native split. Six fit days, one stop day, one calibrate day.
